-- Add email verification codes table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emailVerifications (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  businessId INT,
  verificationType ENUM('claim', 'submission') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claim',
  isVerified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Add googleMapsUrl column to businesses
ALTER TABLE businesses ADD COLUMN googleMapsUrl VARCHAR(500) AFTER googleReviewCount;

-- Rename "Therapist" to "Sport Psychologist" in businessTypes
UPDATE businessTypes SET name = 'Sport Psychologist', slug = 'sport-psychologist', description = 'Mental performance coaches and sport psychologists helping athletes with mindset, focus, and performance psychology' WHERE slug = 'therapist' OR name = 'Therapist';

-- Also update any businesses that had "therapist" in their type name
-- (the businessTypeId foreign key handles this automatically since we updated the type name)

-- Add sample incentive offers for featured businesses that don't have any
-- First check which featured businesses exist
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.isFeatured, b.isClaimed, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referralOffers ro WHERE ro.businessId = b.id) as offerCount
FROM businesses b WHERE b.isFeatured = 1;
